acceptance: Each Header, Footer, Noise, Separator, and Heading selection independently produces its two-LF spacing; an empty selection removes every non-Story artifact replacement and every inter-block whitespace gap while exact Story text/order remain; the controls occupy exactly two rows with Edit over Save at the right; focused checks pass.
alignment.reason: The user explicitly directs a presentation-only re-render of already validated, retained decisions. The change keeps exact Story slices and ordering intact, does not call the provider, and has focused regression coverage.
scope: AI Cleanup retained-decision rendering, focused contract and Text Cleanup page tests, requirements, and AI Cleanup component documentation. Preserve the six-category model taxonomy, Story exclusion, source ordering, and no-provider reapplication.
alignment.source: User report 2026-07-15: selectors do not all visibly change the cleaned preview; deselecting every selector cannot remove pre-existing blank lines; requested two-row grid has label/Heading/Separator/Edit first row and Apply Spacing/Noise/Header/Footer/Save second row.
alignment.understanding: Treat each of the five non-Story category selections as an independent deterministic spacing decision. Keep Story slices exact, but make validated whitespace-only gaps between blocks render as no spacing so an empty selection leaves no controllable inter-block blank lines. Replace the current separate selector and action layouts with one two-row grid beneath Cleaned Text Preview: label, Heading, Separator, Edit on row one; Apply Spacing, Noise, Header, Footer, Save on row two, with Edit and Save vertically aligned at the right.

intent.statement: Make every selectable AI Cleanup spacing category re-render reliably, allow deselecting all categories to remove controllable inter-block blank lines while retaining Story content, and arrange Apply Spacing plus selectors and vertical Edit/Save controls in exactly two rows under the cleaned preview.

examples: With two Story blocks separated by a source blank line and five classified artifacts, selecting only Footer renders only Footer as two LF; selecting none renders no two-LF artifact or inter-block gap.
spec_items.statement: AI Cleanup spacing reapplication shall make every non-Story artifact category independently selectable and render retained whitespace-only gaps as no spacing, so deselecting all categories removes all controllable inter-block blank lines while exact Story slices remain ordered and unchanged.

examples: At the default desktop page width, all five selectors and action buttons remain accessible without a third control row.
spec_items.statement: The cleaned-preview controls shall occupy exactly two grid rows: label, Heading, Separator, Edit on row one; Apply Spacing, Noise, Header, Footer, Save on row two, with Edit over Save at the right.
